title: Lunar events in your personal calendar
description: The dates you want can be added to your own plans, with the reminder frequency you choose.

blocks.text: Copying the dates you care about out of a separate app every time is awkward. What is needed is calendar access you control.

quote.text: Love this app,it's wonderful-only downfall is that not all info can be added to calendar,only a couple of things can be-would be PERFECT(5 star) if/when that happens- it is worth the price though-(wish the astrological info of the moon phases was able to be put into the calendar)

blocks.text: Let the type of events, the period and the destination calendar be chosen. Show a preview and a way to undo the addition.
Reconcile the time zone and the handling of a repeat import. Personal or cultural readings should not look like a scientific forecast of events in someone’s life.
